contexts.text: Tyre = those who possess spiritual and heavenly riches.
Tyre = those who possessed the Knowledges of celestial and spiritual things. AC 1156. ( = the possession of Knowledges. AC 1232. AC 1462:4.)

Tyre and Sidon were the ultimate boundaries of Philistia, and indeed next the sea, and therefore by Tyre are signified interior Knowledges, and by Sidon exterior Knowledges, of spiritual things. Illustrated. AC 2576:8.
Philistia as far as Tyre and Sidon a country of the Ancient Church. AC 2385:5. AC 3240:5. Treated of.
Tyre, Sidon, and Philistia = Knowledges.
Tyre = the Knowledges of truth. AC 2466:5. AC 3727:8.
The merchandise of Tyre () = Knowledges.
The name Tyre = Knowledges. AC 4453:end.
Tyre = those in the Knowledges of good and truth. AC 3268:4.
Tyre = the Knowledges of good and truth. Illustrated. AC 3923:5. AC 3941:7. AC 4599:3. AC 5954:6. AC 6385:2. AC 6419:2. AC 6508:2. AC 7770:4. AC 8337:4. AC 9325:4. AC 9340:5. DSS 45.
Tyre = the interior Knowledges of good and truth; thus those who are in them.
Tyre and Sidon = the Knowledges of good and truth; and also those in them. AC 9295:end. DSS 18:3.
The prince of Tyre () = the primary things of the Knowledges of truth and good. ( = those in principles of falsity. AC 4728:6.) ( = the intelligence which is from the Knowledges of truth. AE 131.)
Tyre = the Ancient Church, but as to the Knowledges of good and truth. AC 5620:5.

The opinion about faith alone... is described... also by Tyre and Sidon in the Prophets, where by the Philistines are signified the knowledge of the Knowledges of faith; and by Tyre and Sidon, the Knowledges themselves interior and exterior.
For the sea where were Tyre and Sidon, was the boundary of the land of Philistia; and by Tyre and Sidon are signified the Knowledges of truth and good.
Tyre = the Church as to the (interior) Knowledges of truth and good. AC 10227:12. AC 10570:6. DSS 97:4. DLW 325. AR 406:2. TCR 467. AE 141:13.
Tyre = those in the Knowledges of truth and good; in the abstract sese, these Knowledges themselves.
Tyre, in the internal representative sense, = those who are in intelligence and wisdom from the Knowledges of good and truth. Treated of.
How it was that the science of correspondences came to be cultivated in Tyre and Sidon, etc. DSS 102.
The king of Tyre () = the Word where and whence are the Knowledges of truth and good. ( = the Knowledges of the truth of the Church from the literal sense of the Word. AE 717:9.)
The Ancient Word existed in Tyre and Sidon, etc.
Tyre = the Church as to the Knowledges of truth and good, thus as to intelligence.
As the sea = Divine truth with those in the boundaries of Heaven, Tyre and Sidon, because next the sea, = the Church as to the Knowledges of good and truth.
Tyre = the Church as to the Knowledges of truth from the Word.
Tyre = the Knowledges of truth and good, which are introductory truths.
Tyre... heapeth up silver as dust, and gold as the mire of the streets (). Here Tyre = those who acquire Knowledges for themselves.
Tyre and Sidon = those within the Church who are in the Knowledges of truth and good; here () those who have perverted these, and have applied them to falsities and to the evils of falsity.
Tyre is laid waste () = that there were no longer any Knowledges of truth. AE 406:11. AE 514:5.
Tyre = the Church as to the Knowledges of spiritual truth and good; here (verses 15-16) the Church in which these have been falsified.
Tyre = the Church as to the Knowledges of truth.
The report concerning Tyre () = the Knowledges from the Word devastated by the falsities and evils to which they are applied.
The kings of Tyre and Sidon () = the Knowledges of truth and good from the Word in the natural man; for all (these) Knowledges, as such, are in the natural man.
To cut off from Tyre and Sidon every helper that remaineth () = that they have no Knowledge of truth and good.
The daughter of Tyre () = the affection of the Knowledges of truth and good. AE 863:14.
Tyre and Sidon, and the Philistines () = those who have falsified the truths and goods of the Word.
Tyre = the Church as to the Knowledges of truth and good; thus Tyre = the Knowledges of truth and good which are of the Church. The devastation of this is here signified ().
Tyre is treated of in  and as Tyre = the Knowledges of truth and good, her trading is treated of, and the various wares by which she was enriched. Explained. AE 840:6.
The merchandise of Tyre () = the Knowledges of truth and good of every kind.
Sidon and Tyre (verses 4-5) = the Knowledges of good and truth from the Word: that the Church has not by means of them acquired anything of intelligence and wisdom, nor wrought any uses. Signified.
